title: Bank Deposit First-Transfer Promotion Terms
content:
Two Bank Deposit tiers carry a promotion for the customer's first-ever personal transfer: the transfer fee is waived and a promotional exchange-rate margin applies, up to a principal cap. The promotion is a tier term; the other four tiers carry none.

## Promotion figures

| Tier | Fee waived on a first transfer | Largest principal covered (USD) | Promotional margin (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | yes | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 1.10 |
| Bank Deposit Express | yes | 500.00 | 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 1.25 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 0.55 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | no | 0.00 (no promotion) | 0.85 |

## Terms

1. The fee waiver applies to the customer's first-ever personal transfer when it is booked on a tier whose fee-waiver term is yes.
2. The cap is the largest principal the promotion covers. Above it the regular price applies to the whole transfer, not only to the part above the cap. A cap of 0.00 means the tier has no promotion.
3. The promotional margin is the exchange-rate margin applied to a first transfer the promotion covers. On the four tiers without a promotion the listed margin is the same as the tier's ordinary margin and never comes into play.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical first transfers)

| Tier | Principal | Covered by the promotion? |
|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 1000.00 | yes (at the cap) |
| Bank Deposit Economy | 1000.01 | no; regular price on the whole transfer |
| Bank Deposit Express | 500.00 | yes (at the cap) |
| Bank Deposit Express | 500.01 | no; regular price on the whole transfer |
